data.answer: TagZ Foods, a Bengaluru-based food tech startup, experienced a significant revenue drop, reporting a 90% decrease in operating revenue to ₹1.3 crore in FY25 from ₹14.14 crore in FY24. The company's revenue was largely driven by one-time gains, such as the sale of intangible assets, rather than core business operations. TagZ Foods was acquired by Consumer Products for ~₹28 crore, seen as a distress sale due to scaling challenges and sustained losses. Despite the revenue decline, TagZ Foods raised $4.0M in total across 4 funding rounds, with its latest funding round being $2.0M in May 2023. The company has 19 institutional investors and 65 angel investors.
